_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the craft judge returned them, round 2; each why abridged by the run.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bold register and true blacks; several frames lean on kit primitives: 4's glowing mannequin, 7's noise strata and dot rig, 8's blinds, the cover's boxes, 9's dead band; 6 best lit; 2 reads well; 5 bold with a sticker band.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, one grade; both devices work; the reliefs sit slightly outside; band colour drifts.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; c8 and c24 apart; slide 6 'set' looser than c25; slide 2 headline generalises one rig; c3 quoted but not listed.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, where and what named; safety and jobs stakes concrete; no body or action.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns it, 2 pays, 6 turns; 2 and 3 and 4 and 5 pair up; 7 a side road.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Permian vocabulary; disclaimers read as housekeeping.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject and accent; floodlit world and oilfield setting familiar.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Glowing mannequin is the brightest object; feet cut; plain doghouse.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A rim-lit silhouette on grating with a contact shadow; crop the doghouse.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Uniform noise strata, no pool, dot rig.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Distinct raked strata bands, only the lateral groove lit.
Grazing light so each joint casts, lit rusted beams, raised bands.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Stacked rounded boxes, no jaws, blurred shaft.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Jaw halves with die pads on a sharp lit pipe, loom and grime.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Dead dirt band, primitive substructure, mast competes, footer on the beam.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower and push in so the rack fills the bottom half; crop the mast.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The lit third reads as texture, not light.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One grating, three panels lit by the pool.
